svg.aria-label: The cube map unfolded flat, each face as its image is stored: +Y (layer 2) above +Z, the row -X (1), +Z (4), +X (0), -Z (5), and -Y (3) below +Z. Arrows on each face give its right and down: +Y right +X and down +Z, -Y right +X and down -Z, and the four in the row all down -Y, with right +Z, +X, -Z and -X in turn.
